title: 🔍 Prepositions of place & Where is/are?
description: Учим предлоги места (in, on, under, behind, between, next to) и смотрим квартиру с юмором. Уровень A0. 6 дней.

days.title: Day 1: Prepositions of Place — in, on, under
days.description: Учим основные предлоги места: в, на, под

grammar.title: Prepositions of Place — in, on, under
grammar.rule:
Предлоги места показывают, ГДЕ находится предмет.

📦 in — внутри, в (в ящике, в комнате, в шкафу)
📦 on — на поверхности (на столе, на полу, на стене)
📦 under — под (под кроватью, под столом, под диваном)

🎯 Лайфхак: in = внутри, on = сверху, under = снизу.
🎯 Мем: 'My phone is in my hand. My charger is on the floor. My motivation is under the bed.' 📱😅
examples: Leo: 'My phone is in my pocket. Where are my headphones? On the table!' 🎧
Mia: 'The cat is under the sofa. She hides there when the vacuum is on.' 🐱🧹
Sam: 'There is a monster under my bed. Actually, it's just my dirty socks.' 👻🧦

vocabulary.example: The pencil is in the pencil case.
The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
The toy is in the box.
My sock is under the bed.

exercises.question: Where is the pen? ✒️
exercises.explanation: Pen is INSIDE the box — in the box! 📦

exercises.question: Where is the book? 📖
exercises.explanation: Book is ON TOP of the table — on the table!

exercises.question: The cat is ___ the chair. (under / on)
exercises.explanation: Кошка ПОД стулом — under! 🐱

exercises.question: The phone is ___ my pocket. (in / on)
exercises.explanation: Телефон В кармане — in! 📱

exercises.question: If a book is on the table, it is inside the table.
exercises.explanation: On the table — НА столе, не внутри! 📖

days.title: Day 2: Prepositions of Place — behind, between, next to
days.description: Учим предлоги: за, между, рядом с

grammar.title: Prepositions — behind, between, next to
grammar.rule:
Продолжаем изучать предлоги места:

🚪 behind — за, позади (за дверью, за диваном)
🚪 between — между (между двумя предметами)
🚪 next to — рядом с (рядом с кем-то или чем-то)

🎯 Лайфхак: behind = сзади, between = в середине (между двумя), next to = сбоку.
🎯 Мем: 'I am between my bed and my alarm clock. I don't want to get up.' ⏰😴
examples: Leo: 'The remote control is behind the TV. I found it after three days!' 📺
Mia: 'My house is between the school and the park. Very convenient!' 🏠
Sam: 'I sit next to Leo in class. He talks too much!' 🗣️

vocabulary.example: The ball is behind the sofa.
The book is between the lamp and the clock.
The school is next to the park.
The picture is on the wall.
The clock is on the wall.

exercises.question: Where is the cat? 🐱
exercises.explanation: Cat is BEHIND the box — за коробкой!

exercises.question: Where is the ball? ⚽
exercises.explanation: Ball is BETWEEN the chairs — между стульями!

exercises.question: The school is ___ the bank. (next to / between)
exercises.explanation: School is NEXT TO the bank — рядом с банком! 🏫

exercises.question: The cat is hiding ___ the sofa. (behind / next to)
exercises.explanation: Cat is hiding BEHIND the sofa — за диваном! 🐱

exercises.question: If you sit between two friends, you sit next to both of them.
exercises.explanation: Between = в середине, рядом с обоими! 👥

days.title: Day 3: English in Use — Viewing a house

grammar.title: Viewing a House — Useful Phrases
grammar.rule:
Когда смотришь квартиру для аренды или покупки, полезно знать эти фразы:

💬 Estate agent (риелтор):
• 'Let me show you around.' — Позвольте показать вам.
• 'This is the living room.' — Это гостиная.
• 'The kitchen is on the left.' — Кухня слева.

💬 You (покупатель/арендатор):
• 'How many bedrooms are there?' — Сколько спален?
• 'Is there a garden?' — Есть сад?
• 'How much is the rent?' — Сколько арендная плата?
• 'What floor is it on?' — На каком этаже?

🎯 Мем: 'Is there a washing machine?' — 'There is, but it only plays music.' 🎵🧺
examples: Agent: 'This is the living room. There is a beautiful view.' 🌅
Leo: 'How many bedrooms are there?' Agent: 'Two.' Leo: 'Perfect for me and my games!' 🎮
Mia: 'Is there a garden?' Agent: 'Yes, but it's very small.' Mia: 'Perfect for my cat!' 🐱
grammar.keywords: viewing a house, estate agent, how many, how much, what floor, garden, rent

vocabulary.context_example: У нас просмотр дома в 3 часа.

exercises.explanation: Floor — этаж! 🏢

exercises.explanation: Estate agent — риелтор! 🏡

exercises.question: 'Let me show you around' means the estate agent will give you a tour.
exercises.explanation: Yes! 'Show you around' — показать вам квартиру! 🏠

days.title: Day 4: Describing a room — all prepositions together
days.description: Соединяем все предлоги для описания комнаты

grammar.title: Describing a Room with Prepositions
grammar.rule:
Теперь мы можем полноценно описать комнату!

📌 Структура: [There is/are] + [предмет] + [предлог] + [место]

✅ There is a lamp on the desk. 💡
✅ There are two chairs next to the table. 🪑
✅ The cat is under the bed. 🐱
✅ The picture is behind the sofa. 🖼️
✅ The books are between the bookends. 📚

🎯 Мем: 'My homework is on the table. My motivation is under the bed. My phone is in my hand.' 📱
examples: Leo: 'There is a computer on my desk. There are games under the bed. There is a poster on the wall.' 💻
Mia: 'There is a mirror behind the door. There are shoes next to the wardrobe.' 👟
Sam: 'There is a pizza box between the books. Don't tell my mum!' 🍕
grammar.keywords: describe a room, prepositions, there is, there are

vocabulary.example: The mirror is on the wall.
I do my homework at my desk.
vocabulary.context_example: Я делаю уроки за письменным столом.

vocabulary.example: The teddy bear is on the bed.
The game console is next to the TV.
Where is my phone charger?

exercises.question: The mirror is ___ the wall. 🪞
exercises.explanation: Mirror is ON the wall — на стене!

exercises.question: The charger is ___ the bed and the wardrobe. 🔌
exercises.explanation: Charger is BETWEEN the bed and the wardrobe — между кроватью и шкафом!

exercises.question: There is a lamp ___ the desk. (on / under)
exercises.explanation: Lamp is ON the desk — на столе! 💡

exercises.question: The teddy bear is ___ the bed. (on / under)
exercises.explanation: Teddy bear is ON the bed — на кровати! 🧸

exercises.question: The cat is on the bed.
exercises.explanation: The sentence is correct! 🐱

days.title: Day 5: Practice — All prepositions + house viewing
days.description: Повторяем предлоги и фразы для просмотра квартиры

grammar.title: Revision: Prepositions + Viewing a House
grammar.rule:
Сегодня проверяем себя! 🎯

📌 Предлоги: in, on, under, behind, between, next to
📌 Фразы: How many bedrooms?, How much is the rent?, What floor?, Is there a garden?
📌 Описание комнаты: There is a sofa in the living room. The TV is on the wall.

🎯 Вопрос: Where is the washing machine? — It's in the kitchen, next to the fridge.
examples: Where is the phone? — It's in my hand, as always. 📱
Where is the homework? — It's on the desk. Under a pile of pizza boxes. 🍕
Where is the cat? — Behind the sofa. Hiding from the dog. 🐱🐶
grammar.keywords: revision, prepositions, house viewing, describe room

exercises.question: What do you ask to know the floor? 🏢
exercises.explanation: What floor is it on? — На каком этаже?

exercises.question: The keys are ___ the table. (next to / between)
exercises.explanation: Keys are NEXT TO the table — рядом со столом! 🔑

exercises.question: There is a poster ___ the wall. (on / in)
exercises.explanation: Poster is ON the wall — на стене! 🖼️

exercises.question: The remote control is ___ the sofa. (behind / between)
exercises.explanation: Remote is BEHIND the sofa — за диваном! 📺

exercises.explanation: Books are ON the shelf — на полке, не внутри! 📚

days.title: Day 6: Reading — The Mystery of Leo's Missing Phone
days.description: Читаем детективную историю о поисках пропавшего телефона

grammar.title: Reading: The Mystery of Leo's Missing Phone
grammar.rule: Сегодня читаем историю о том, как Leo потерял телефон и искал его по всей квартире. Используем предлоги места!

exercises.question: Where did Leo look first? 🔍
exercises.explanation: Leo looked in his bedroom first.
exercises.readingText:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔍 THE MYSTERY OF LEO'S MISSING PHONE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 SCENE: Leo's house. Leo is panicking.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LEO: 'Where is my phone?! I need it! My battery is at 2%!'

MIA: 'Calm down, Leo. Where did you last have it?'

LEO: 'I don't know! I was in my bedroom, then in the kitchen, then in the bathroom...'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MIA: 'Let's search together! Is it in your bedroom?'

LEO: (looks under the pillow) 'No.'

MIA: 'Is it on the desk?'

LEO: 'No. There is only a pizza box on the desk.' 🍕

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MIA: 'Let's check the kitchen. Is it on the table?'

LEO: 'No, there is a plate on the table.'

MIA: 'Is it in the fridge?'

LEO: 'Why would my phone be in the fridge?'

MIA: 'I don't know! Just check!'

LEO: (opens fridge) 'No phone. But there is pizza. Want some?' 🍕

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MIA: 'FOCUS, LEO! Check the bathroom.'

LEO: (goes to bathroom) 'Is it behind the mirror?' → No.

LEO: 'Is it next to the sink?' → No.

LEO: 'Is it in the washing machine?'

MIA: 'Did you put your phone in the washing machine?!'

LEO: 'No! But my socks are there.' 🧦

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MIA: 'Last place: the living room. Is it under the sofa?'

LEO: (looks under sofa) 'No. Just dust and one old french fry.' 🍟

MIA: 'Is it between the cushions?'

LEO: (checks between cushions) 'NO!'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LEO: (sits on the sofa, puts hand in pocket) 'Oh. It's in my pocket.'

MIA: '...'

LEO: 'It was in my pocket the whole time.' 😐

MIA: 'Leo, you are... special.'

LEO: 'At least my battery is still at 2%!' 📱

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MIA: 'Let's never talk about this again.'

LEO: 'Agreed. Want pizza?' 🍕

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
